scope: All sealed DS6 switches and real transactions/events; no new tracker or score, no old file changed, no GT raster read. Existing postseal RGB identity facts are used only for explanation, not decision tuning.

decisive_mechanism.location: experiments/ms1_s0_development_8400/merge_split_manager.py: stage_group_restore changes compared to view.mapping; before() q populates protected outputs from temporary numeric choice.
decisive_mechanism.effect: Accepting the guessed preview creates persistent event aliases even when transaction.changes is empty. Five wrong H1 acceptances cause all ten additional switches; F419/F519 correct D2 H2 commits cancel a guessed permutation and keep continuous native IDs.

minimal_repair.publication: Keep current causal own-branch event aliases or native IDs during protected evidence collection and q preview; no provisional H1/H2 or borrowed carrier label may reach publication.
minimal_repair.fallback: Remove only this episode protection from a clone of this branch pre-frame engine, run one current causal step, and commit its complete legal engine/mapping; never copy another baseline branch and never transplant guessed q preview.
minimal_repair.accepted_mapping: Only explicit admitted event mapping enters inherited stage_group_restore guards. Against a lawful alias/native view, changes is a real current baseline delta. Preserve outside observations/banks/aliases and reject occupied or duplicate public targets atomically.
minimal_repair.logging: Keep baseline-relative action, previous-published continuous-source delta, newly seen sources, and native override separate. Old COMMIT/NO_ID_CHANGE are preview-relative and cannot establish absence/presence of published identity effects.
minimal_repair.depth_support: Missing/DEFER uses own causal alias/native fallback, not mandatory geometry permutation. Sparse evidence may be marginalized with candidate-consistent uninformative terms; its score use and whether it authorizes a nonnative write must be separate. No hand-approved source or GT-tuned threshold.
minimal_repair.minimal_arms: Include unchanged SAM3_NATIVE and old DS6/D2 controls; new lawful publication with no event writes must exactly reproduce same native on full 1471 frames; isolate lawful publication alone, then depth-supported writes, then optional existing repaired-depth source. Root freezes/runs final arms.
risks: Lawful publication alone prevents implicit swaps only if score-missing decisions actually release to lawful fallback; explicitly accepting geometry H1 would still create the same five swaps.
Preserving native on low evidence can lose the four legitimate old-ID reconnections; quantify full-run tradeoff, not selected-q performance.

F1263 has four depth edges yet both candidates have nearly equal depth cost and geometry chooses wrong. Availability alone is insufficient authorization; a mapping that overrides native needs actual discriminating support.
Qualified native co-visibility with an incumbent event alias needs original native-return lifecycle; naive alias.get(native,native) can duplicate IDs.
Protected bank/native stores and outside alias/native domains must stay separate. A pure spec.outputs rewrite can hide aliases from outside native-return checks and create occupation errors.
Depth surface identity/physical RGB-D calibration and repaired-depth causal lineage remain separate unknowns; RGB polygon correspondence is not depth surface truth.

public_privacy: Statistics, anonymous source/public identities, postseal scalar RGB correspondence labels and paths/hashes only; no pixel xy/native indices/raw depth arrays/RLE/RGB/GT raster.
